There are several factors to consider when you choose the multi-tenancy strategy in
If you expect to support a very large number of tenants (millions or more), use the partition key-level strategy.
Choose database, collection, or partition-level strategies if you have strict physical data isolation requirements.
Flexible data schema for each tenant's data:

. If your tenants' data structures are different, choose database-level or collection-level multi-tenancy.
